## About

Nick Tan is a software engineer and entrepreneur. He spent over eight years, most recently as a Senior Software Engineer, building enterprise data discovery software in C++, and now works with AI. Alongside that he runs three businesses and builds the software they need. He is open to roles, consulting and collaborations.

## Expertise

### Systems
Over eight years on a large enterprise C++ codebase: file scanning that runs on Windows, Linux and macOS (PDF and Office formats), and connectors for databases (MariaDB/MySQL, PostgreSQL), cloud storage (Dropbox, S3, Google Workspace) and servers.

### AI
Building with LLMs: question answering over documents with citations (RAG), agents, MCP servers, and red teaming prompts against injection and tool abuse. Also MLOps pipelines and training vision, time series and NLP models.

### Operations
Running an online store end to end: suppliers, listings, ads and fulfilment, on a self-built back office for orders, shipping labels and stock sync.

### Product
Turning requirements into specifications and proof-of-concepts with Product and UI/UX teams, and acting as the tier-3 engineering contact for complex customer issues.

Online pet supply store in Singapore, founded in 2026. Runs on a back office Nick built: orders, shipping labels, packing slips, supplier stock sync and a Telegram bot for day-to-day operations.

Building inspection and consultancy in Singapore, founded in 2024. Nick is prototyping AI that turns site notes and photos into defect reports.

Premium playing cards and hobby supplies. Caters to cardists, magicians, and collectors. Operates on the Shopee platform in Singapore.

## Current Projects

### Ourobor-OS
URL: nick-tan.com/ourobor-os
Status: Active

Observability and documentation for a codebase, shipped as an agent skill for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor and other LLM tools. Keeps a living, LLM-maintained wiki that explains what the code does and why, and flags comments, TODOs and existing docs that the code has since contradicted. Capture is built into the development workflow so the docs stay in sync with the code, and a static site generator publishes the wiki as a browsable site. It started from finding it a chore to keep documentation updated, and is growing into a sidecar companion that observes the codebase.

## Chrome Extensions

### OOTD Transcript Downloader
URL: nick-tan.com/ootd-transcript-downloader
Status: Active

A browser extension that downloads YouTube transcripts in one click so they can be fed straight into an AI. Runs locally; data never leaves the user's machine.

### Data Bouncer
URL: nick-tan.com/data-bouncer
Status: Active

A browser extension that converts and sanitizes webpages and articles into clean markdown formats optimized for LLM ingestion. Strips noise (ads, nav, boilerplate) and produces structured markdown that modern language models can process accurately.
